mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", step_id AS "stepId", threshold AS "threshold", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.execute_effect_details WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND step_id = #{stepId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.execute_effect_details (game_id, step_id, threshold, change_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{stepId}, #{threshold}, #{changeRevision}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, step_id) DO UPDATE SET threshold = EXCLUDED.threshold, change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", step_id AS "stepId", threshold AS "threshold", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.execute_effect_details WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ORDER BY change_revision, step_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.execute_effect_details_log ( game_id, version_id, change_revision, step_id, threshold ) SELECT game_id, #{versionId}, change_revision, step_id, threshold FROM public.execute_effect_details WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ON CONFLICT (game_id, step_id, version_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, threshold = EXCLUDED.threshold
